async_lookup: Use the existing executor and actual taskId to query recordInfo; retain raw response and ledger evidence.
sync_timeout: Chat requests may have no queryable taskId. Recover saved responses locally; absent an actual supported lookup, preserve unknown status and fees. No automatic duplicate submission.
credential_handling: Only the executor reads .env; never ask for browser cookies, dashboard passwords or screenshots.
